verified: Quaise Energy said Google agreed to buy 50 MW of carbon-free power from Project Obsidian, its first commercial superhot geothermal project, near Newberry, Oregon, per the company's Tuesday announcement.
unconfirmed: When the plant would deliver power, what Google will pay, whether the project has secured financing or permits, and whether superhot geothermal can produce power at commercial scale — none of this was disclosed, and the reporting rests on Quaise's announcement rather than independent operational data.

verified: Quaise 在周二的公告中表示，谷歌同意购买 Project Obsidian 的 50 兆瓦无碳电力，这是该项目的首个客户。
unconfirmed: 项目投运时间、电价、钻井与发电性能，以及谷歌是否另行确认；报道未提供这些信息。

titles.en: Google to buy 50 MW from Quaise's first superhot geothermal project
titles.zh: 谷歌同意采购 Quaise 50 兆瓦超热地热电力
